mapper.select: SELECT FROM edu.asset_generation_jobs WHERE course_id=#{courseId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM edu.asset_generation_jobs WHERE course_id=#{courseId} AND asset_id=#{assetId}
SELECT FROM edu.asset_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM edu.asset_generation_jobs WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.asset_generation_jobs SET status='PROCESSING',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE edu.asset_generation_jobs SET status='READY_FOR_REVIEW',callback_event_id=#{callbackEventId},error_message=NULL,error_details=NULL,tikz_source=#{tikzSource},model=#{model},parameters=CAST(#{parametersJson} AS jsonb),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE edu.asset_generation_jobs SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{message},error_details=#{details},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
UPDATE edu.asset_generation_jobs SET status='PENDING',attempt=attempt+1,callback_event_id=NULL,error_message=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,completed_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'

UPDATE edu.asset_generation_jobs SET prompt=#{prompt},status='PENDING',attempt=attempt+1,callback_event_id=NULL,error_message=NULL,error_details=NULL,tikz_source=NULL,model=NULL,parameters='{}'::jsonb,generation_mode='REGENERATE',output_storage_key=#{outputStorageKey},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,completed_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('READY_FOR_REVIEW','FAILED')
